args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money

The docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212)
but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing 2.665 to round to
2.67 instead of 2.66. Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the spec and tests.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

## Changes
- `round_money` now uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` via `Decimal.quantize`, so halves round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 → 2.66).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` (commit 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
